154:     Filter out runs that did not compile or have all empty patches.
155:     """
156:     run_ids_compiled = []
157: 
158:     logger.info(f"num_swe_issues: {num_swe_issues}")

167: def get_original_score(output_dir):
168:     """
169:     Get the original score from the initial version.
170:     """
171:     metadata = load_json_file(os.path.join(output_dir, "initial", "metadata.json"))
172:     return metadata["overall_performance"]["accuracy_score"]

174: def update_archive(output_dir, archive, new_ids, method='keep_all', noise_leeway=0.1):
175:     """
176:     Update the archive with the new self-improve runs.
177:     """
178:     if method == 'keep_better':
179:         # keep only better ones
180:         original_score = get_original_score(output_dir) - noise_leeway
181:         for run_id in new_ids:
182:             metadata = load_json_file(os.path.join(output_dir, run_id, "metadata.json"))
183:             score = metadata["overall_performance"]["accuracy_score"]
184:             if score >= original_score:
185:                 archive.append(run_id)
186:     else:
187:         # keep everything
188:         archive += new_ids
189: 
190:     return archive
